KaTeX 0.19.0 (MIT license)
Official npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.19.0
Source project: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
Vendored from npm's katex-0.19.0.tgz on 2026-10-11, with no install scripts.
Files: dist/katex.min.js and dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js.
License preserved in KATEX-LICENSE.txt.

This application uses only MathML output, rendered natively by modern Edge,
Chrome and Firefox. No KaTeX CSS, fonts, external CDN, or network request is
needed. Source text is preserved on parse errors. HTML trust is disabled;
strict mode and expansion/size limits are enabled.
